name: Staged: king on the bathroom wall with floating nightstands, a reading chair where the dresser was
notes:
Staged pick, 2026-10-24 (F-64): a king and no dresser. Andrew: "there is a GIANT walk in closet ... so we do NOT need a dresser for sure", "Try to fit a kingsize bed in master, still need nightstands", and of the dresser layouts "Keep the dresser version in tact though as alternaitves, it's still nice": they are b to g, g being the MALM queen staged before. 15 placed, 11 extras; every piece a suggestion in a staged layout (F-50).
A king fits one way only: headboard end on the right (bathroom) wall, between the heater's 12" for bedding (y 18) and the bathroom door's 36" landing (y 97), so the frame can be at most 79" across. The Mellow pine platform is the narrowest king in the catalog, 75.5" (its mattress overhangs it 1/4" a side); the Yaheetech dark-walnut king (amazon-B0DWMSPBMZ, 78.5") is the darker option, closer to the MALM, and leaves 12.5" from the heater face; the MALM King (82 1/4") and the TARVA King (79 1/8") don't fit the slot. The floor beside the head belongs to the heater on the window side and to the bathroom landing on the other, so both nightstands are LACK wall shelves.
bed-1 Mellow king platform, natural pine (floor): right wall, rot 90, x 97.5-177, y 21.5-97. F-34: window side 21.5" from the wall and 15.5" from the heater's drawn face along its whole length, since the heater runs the whole wall (tight:15.5); bathroom side 36", to the bottom wall across the bathroom door's landing (F-31, assumed-position:door). F-33: the mattress edge 15.25" from the heater face (12" min); heater-depth-assumed. No headboard: the pillows rest against the wall under the art.
shelf-1, shelf-2 LACK wall shelves (top), the floating nightstands, mirrored about the bed's center line: shelf-2 on the window side, x 166.75-177, y 12-23.75, 6" from the heater's drawn face (F-33); shelf-1 on the bathroom side, y 94.75-106.5, so the bathroom landing's floor stays clear (F-31). Each overlaps the mattress edge by 2.25": mount its top about 27" up, 5 1/2" above the mattress, clear of the duvet. 6.5 lb max each and anchored (IKEA): a phone, a glass, a book.
lamp-1, lamp-2 VARPTROSS bamboo wall lamps (top): one on the head wall above each shelf, x 172-177, y 14.4-21.4 and 97.1-104.1, hung about 24" above the mattress, beside the pillows; plug-in on a 7' 3" cord, run down behind the shelf and along the head wall in a cord cover to an outlet behind the bed, never down past the heater. art-1 PJÄTTERYD endless tide 55x22" (top): right wall over the bed, centered, x 176-177, y 31.75-86.75: about 73% of the bed's width, 10.4" from each lamp.
rug-1 TIOKRONA 7'10"x9'10" jute (rug): rot 0, x 34-152, y 22.5-116.5: under the lower 54.5" of the bed (69%), tucked 1" under its window side, 19.5" past its bathroom side where you step out, and out past the foot to 1.75" short of the reading chair; its far edge meets the BESTÅ column's front; 16.5" off the heater face (F-33). It cannot turn crosswise: from y 18, its 118" would run past the bottom wall. On two STOPP FILT underlays (extras), as its page asks.
bench-1 PERJOHAN pine bench (floor): across the foot, rot 90, x 86.5-97.5, y 39.6-78.9, centered on the bed: pine with the pine frame, a seat and blanket storage.
chair-1 POÄNG (floor): the reading corner where the dresser stood, left wall, rot 270, x 0-32.25, y 21-47.75, facing the bed. F-33: upholstery 15" from a full-wall heater face (12" min). floor-lamp-1 TÅGARP (floor): beside it in the window-side corner, x 0-9, y 12-21; F-33: 6" from the heater face; heater-depth-assumed. side-table-1 LACK side table, white stained oak effect (floor): at the chair's right arm, left wall, rot 270, x 0-21.6, y 48.75-70.4, for a cup and a book; plant-1 FEJKA areca palm on it (top), x 1.5-6.25, y 64-68.75.
hamper-1 PURRPINGLA (floor): in the 8" of wall between the bathroom door and the right wall, rot 180, x 169-177, y 115.75-133, by the bathroom and out of the entry's and the bed's view; F-31: beside the bathroom landing, not in it (assumed-position:door: if the door sits nearer the corner, the hamper goes in the walk-in closet).
storage-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors, 23 5/8x16 1/2x76" (floor): bottom wall at the closet end of the 70" run, rot 180, x 70-93.6, y 116.5-133: linens and towels. F-31: 3" to the side of the closet's 36" landing (assumed-position:closet); anchor-required (F-21: 76").
mirror-1 NISSEDAL 25 5/8x59" (top): hung vertically on the walkway stretch of the 70" wall, rot 180, x 103.8-129.4, opposite the window, so it carries daylight into the room.
Walkways (F-30): from the door to the bathroom along the bottom of the room, 37.6" between the bench and the BESTÅ column, then 36" beside the bed; 54" between the reading chair and the bench (64.9" from the side table) up to the window side; the closet's and the bathroom door's 36" landings stay clear (F-31, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:door).
Extras: the king's VALEVÅG mattress x1 (ships rolled, F-22), DVALA King sheet set x1, SMÅSPORRE King insert x1, ÄNGSLILJA King cover set, natural x1, VILDKORN Queen pillows x2 (the DVALA King's cases are 20x36, king pillows; none in the catalog), FJÄDRAR inner cushions x2 in VALLKRASSING gray-green covers x2, VALLKRASSING throw x1, BENGTA block-out panels x2 on the HUGAD rod x1 (about 107", centered on the window; cut the drop to end above the heater, F-33; assumed-position:window), STOPP FILT underlays x2 under the rug.
Not placed: a dresser (the walk-in closet holds the clothes; the STORKLINTA is in b to g); the VIHALS floor nightstand (its corner is the heater's 6"); the STORSEGEL table lamps (12" tall on a mattress-height shelf: too low to read by, crowding a 6.5-lb shelf, and on the window side its cord ran into the heater's corner; the wall lamps replace them); the MALM King ikea-09574348 and the TARVA King ikea-09418584 (82 1/4" and 79 1/8": too wide for the slot); the Yaheetech king amazon-B0DWMSPBMZ (the darker option, 12.5" from the heater face).
Total $1,953.75: placed $1,134.87 + extras $818.88; prices as of 2026-10-22 (price-stale, F-02), 2026-10-23 (the BESTÅ column and the wall lamps) and 2026-10-24 (the king frame, mattress and bedding). Before the audit, $1,886.78; the old staged MALM queen with the dresser, now g, was $1,938.79.
Flags across the layout: tight:15.5 (bed-1, F-34), heater-depth-assumed, assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, anchor-required (storage-1).
Audit 2026-10-24: the king stays where it is, the only arrangement every rule allows (on the left wall it would mirror this with its head beside the room door). The window-side shelf stood 3.75" from the heater's drawn face (against-heater) carrying a 12" table lamp whose cord dropped into the heater's corner: it now sits 6" off the face, the bathroom-side shelf mirrors it, and bamboo wall lamps hang above both, so nothing stands on a shelf to knock off in the dark. The rug showed a 3.5" sliver past the window side and stopped 7.75" short of the chair: it now tucks under that side, gives the bathroom side 19.5" and reaches to 1.75" from the chair, on underlays so it can't slide. The hamper left the entry, where it was the first thing seen and what the bed faced, for the corner by the bathroom door, and the reading chair gained a side table. Still open: measure the heater; if its face is 3" off the wall, the window side is 18.5" with nothing moved. Fit window stops: the bed's window side is 21.5" from the window wall and its foot end lies beside the window (assumed-position:window), and Maddie climbs.
